paragraphs: I intend to be a part of an organization where I can constantly learn and develop my technical and management skills and make the best use of it. I believe in teamwork and hard work. I want to serve in a competitive and challenging environment and achieve goals while being a dedicated team player.

experience.description: I have contributed to various services in the Reganalytics application, such as developing the tax-news briefing app Regbrief and the organizational chart analysis tool Company Data. Additionally I developed a customized mailing system. Within Company Data, I used the yFiles library to create visual charts and controls, facilitating the comprehension of data analysis and organizational structure.
responsibilities: Built scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET Core and React.
Developed key features of the Reganalytics tax analytics platform, including Regbrief and Company Data modules.
Collaborated with stakeholders, including product managers and UX/UI designers, to define requirements and enhance the software development process as a full-stack engineer.
Manage the full lifecycle of software projects. This includes planning, executing, and monitoring projects from start to finish, as well as ensuring that projects meet requirements and deadlines.

experience.description: AKIJ, Apon Wellbeing Ltd. and Madina Group are the ERP Systems on which I have collaborated. Additionally, I've developed a few libraries and services. Worked with some interesting and unique features for the ERP Systems including Procurement, Inventory, Notification, Approval management system etc.
responsibilities: Built and maintained ERP modules for Procurement, Inventory and Approval Management.
Developed RESTful APIs using .NET Core (C#) for ERP integration.
Implemented new features, resolved bugs, and optimized application performance.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver client-specific solutions.
